attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It carries no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, although what it reports of her it reports «Σύμφωνα με την παράδοση», according to tradition; the distinction between an unvouched entry and a traditional one is the site's and is kept here. Nothing in the corpus answers to the name. Her daughter Domitilla, whom the page keeps on 12 Μαΐου, has no folder, so she is named in the life without a link. No hymn.
